Introduction

Nagomi is a Japanese-British singer under 143 Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group MADEIN and the sub unit MADEIN S.

On September 2, 2023, Nagomi was revealed as a contestant on the survival show "PRODUCE 101 JAPAN THE GIRLS". She was eliminated in the tenth episode, during the third ranking announcement, after placing 23rd overall.

On May 10, 2024, Nagomi was announced as a new member of the girl group MADEIN under 143 Entertainment, and will make her debut in Japanese sub-unit MADEIN S with the album "MADE in BLUE" on 14th of August, 2025.
